fullTextParagraphs: How did a group of FedEx team members with limited experience in international shipping dramatically reduce the number of shipments held up by U.S. customs? With big data — and a process that combines design thinking with a FedEx quality improvement program.

When an international shipment has missing or incomplete paperwork, it’s “caged” — held at a secure holding area by customs until the correct information is provided. It’s a costly and negative experience for recipients and shippers alike, so a diverse FedEx team including engineers and analysts set out to improve the process for customers.

The BLADE (Business Leading Analytics Driving the Enterprise) team was determined to create a tool that provided a new level of visibility to international shipments and helped ensure there was a Commercial Invoice — a critical document for customs clearance — with every package.
The team moved extremely fast to produce a solution. The key to their speed: Design ABLE.

Quality Driven Management (QDM) is a unique FedEx approach to quality that helps drive continuous improvement. Design ABLE fuses QDM processes and tools with design thinking to enable rapid testing and the creation of innovative solutions. The team leaned heavily on the four-step QDM process known as ABLE — Assess, Build, Launch, Evaluate — says Ryan Honea, associate project management analyst, FedEx.

“We assessed the need. We worked together to build the tool and launched it. We evaluated it. We saw maybe this isn’t the perfect tool yet, we figured out what we needed to change and then we cycled back. And we kept doing that again and again.”

That rapid iteration is a key feature of design thinking, which fits perfectly with QDM. A FedEx manager of planning and engineering describes the team’s approach: “We failed fast, listened to our customers and worked with them on the fly. But we first educated our leadership team, providing all the information they needed to ensure the couriers understood what was expected of them. We also provided means to measure performance and track it on a global scale.”

The analytics and near-real-time reporting technology the team created gave couriers and other team members information they could use to increase the number of shipments with the correct customs paperwork. Through weekly iterations, getting customer feedback on each one, “in 60 days, we went from a working prototype into our final vision of what’s out in operations now,” Honea says.

In just four months, the use of BLADE resulted in a 10% reduction in caged shipments due to incomplete or missing clearance paperwork — which resulted in improved quality measurements, cost savings and protected revenue. Most important, it helped create better international customer experiences.

“QDM is the backbone of how we were able to identify flaws in those processes and ways to make them better,” Honea says. Donna Cook, vice president of properties and facilities, FedEx, adds: “QDM gave a bunch of individual contributors that didn’t have a lot of background in the international shipping process a recipe for success.”
The FedEx manager says, “The results here have been nothing short of phenomenal, and it took every one of us working together to achieve them.”
With QDM, rapid innovation is within reach for businesses of all sizes in any industry.

notes.meaning: 我们回到前一步继续改进
notes.explain: cycle back 指根据评估结果回到前面的步骤。
notes.example: We cycled back to the alert design after reviewing courier feedback.

notes.explain: through 表示借助持续进行的迭代推进改进。
notes.example: Through weekly iterations, we reduced setup errors.

notes.explain: reduction in + 名词 表示某类问题或数量的减少。
notes.example: The pilot delivered a 10% reduction in late orders.

scenario.title: 运营复盘会：减少缺文件造成的包裹延误
english: International orders are being held because commercial invoices are missing or incomplete.
A pilot tool flags missing paperwork before pickup, but couriers say some alerts are unclear.
Explain the test cycle and recommend what to measure before expanding the tool.
chinese: 国际订单因商业发票缺失或不完整而被海关扣留。
试点工具会在取件前标记缺失文件，但快递员反馈部分提醒不够清楚。
说明测试改进过程，并提出扩大使用前需要衡量什么。

firstAttempt.prompt: 模拟清关流程改进汇报：请用英语说明团队如何测试并迭代工具、取得了什么结果，以及扩大使用前要关注哪些指标。
firstAttempt.sample: We tested BLADE in weekly cycles and used courier and customer feedback to improve it. Within 60 days, we moved from a working prototype to the version now used in operations. After four months, shipments held because of incomplete or missing clearance paperwork had fallen by 10%. Before expanding further, we will track the hold rate, delivery time, and alert accuracy.
firstAttempt.rationale: 先概括迭代过程，再报告实际结果，最后提出下一轮验证指标。

taskPhrases.collocation: state an operational problem with evidence
taskPhrases.example: We found that incomplete customs paperwork was delaying international shipments.
taskPhrases.translation: 我们发现，清关文件不完整正在拖延国际包裹。

taskPhrases.word: We tested…, gathered feedback, and adjusted…
taskPhrases.meaning: 我们测试了……、收集反馈并调整了……
taskPhrases.example: We tested the alert, gathered courier feedback, and adjusted the wording.
taskPhrases.translation: 我们测试了提醒、收集快递员反馈并调整了措辞。

taskPhrases.meaning: 扩大范围前，我们会复核……
taskPhrases.collocation: name the criteria for a rollout decision
taskPhrases.example: Before expanding, we’ll review hold rates and alert accuracy.
taskPhrases.translation: 扩大范围前，我们会复核扣留率和提醒准确率。

words.example: The shipment was delayed because the commercial invoice was incomplete.
words.translation: 商业发票不完整，导致包裹延误。
words.note: 国际货运清关时用于说明货物信息的文件。

words.example: Each weekly iteration included feedback from couriers.
words.translation: 每轮每周迭代都会纳入快递员的反馈。
words.note: 指测试、评估并修改的一轮过程。

words.example: The team tracked the hold rate before and after the change.
words.translation: 团队对比改动前后的扣留率。
words.note: 此处指包裹因文件问题被海关扣留的比例。

structure.original: We saw maybe this isn’t the perfect tool yet, we figured out what we needed to change and then we cycled back.
analysis: figure out 后接需要解决或弄清楚的内容。
cycle back 表示回到前面的步骤，根据评估继续改。
structure.transfer: We reviewed the pilot and figured out what we needed to change before the next test.

rewrite.bad: The process is better now, so we should use the tool everywhere.
rewrite.good: We used weekly courier and customer feedback to improve BLADE. The prototype reached operations in 60 days, and shipments held because of incomplete paperwork fell by 10% over four months. Before expanding further, we will track the hold rate and delivery time.
rewrite.translation: 我们根据快递员和客户每周的反馈改进 BLADE。原型在 60 天内投入运营，四个月后，因文件不完整而被扣留的包裹减少了 10%。进一步扩大使用前，我们会跟踪扣留率和运输时间。
rewrite.pattern: We found [problem]. We tested [change], gathered [feedback], and adjusted [detail]. Before expanding, we’ll review [measures].

cloze.prompt: Each weekly ______ included feedback from couriers.
cloze.why: iteration 指一轮测试、收集反馈和调整。

cloze.prompt: We’ll review the hold ______ before expanding.
cloze.why: hold rate 指包裹因文件问题被扣留的比例。

dictation.text: We figured out what we needed to change and then we cycled back.
dictation.why: 听出先找出修改点，再回到前一步继续迭代。

dictation.text: Through weekly iterations, we went from a prototype to the final vision.
dictation.why: 听清 through weekly iterations，注意持续迭代带来的进展。

translationPractice.prompt: 我们发现，清关文件不完整正在拖延国际包裹。
translationPractice.answer: We found that incomplete customs paperwork was delaying international shipments.
translationPractice.why: 用 We found that 引出清关文件不完整这一运营问题。

translationPractice.prompt: 我们测试了提醒、收集快递员反馈并调整了措辞。
translationPractice.answer: We tested the alert, gathered courier feedback, and adjusted the wording.
translationPractice.why: 说明测试、收集反馈和修改构成的改进过程。

translationPractice.prompt: 扩大范围前，我们会复核扣留率和提醒准确率。
translationPractice.answer: Before expanding, we’ll review hold rates and alert accuracy.
translationPractice.why: 先列出复盘指标，再决定是否扩大使用。

choice.prompt: 新提醒工具减少了部分缺件，但快递员仍误解“缺少发票”的提示。扩大试点前该怎么做？
options: Expand immediately because the hold rate improved.
Clarify the alert, test it again with couriers, and review hold rates and alert accuracy before expanding.
Remove all alerts so couriers are not interrupted.
choice.why: 先处理仍存在的误解，再通过复测和指标判断是否可扩大。

output.prompt: 仓库发现订单经常因标签信息缺失而延迟。请汇报问题、试点改动和扩大前的复核指标。
output.sample: We found that missing labels were delaying orders. We tested a checklist at packing, gathered feedback from warehouse staff, and adjusted the unclear steps. Before expanding, we’ll review labeling errors, dispatch time, and staff feedback.
check: 列出扩大前要复核的指标
